purpose: Read-only terminal action-response and official-cost decomposition on existing student-generated train candidate banks.

source.allowed_split: train only; validation and reserved holdout banks must not be opened

method.terminal_only: For each candidate i, use the official teacher terminal zT_i, frozen student terminal zS_i, and saved goal g. Error e_i=zS_i-zT_i, common b=mean_i(e_i), action contrast q_i=e_i-b.
method.cost_identity: CS_i-CT_i = 2 (zT_i-g) dot b + ||b||^2 + 2 (zT_i-g) dot q_i + 2 b dot q_i + ||q_i||^2
method.score_attribution: After candidate-centering, common term is 2(zT_i-g) dot b; contrast-mediated term is 2(zT_i-g) dot q_i + 2 b dot q_i + ||q_i||^2. Their centered sum equals centered total cost error.
method.oracle_controls: Remove-common uses zS_i-b; remove-contrast uses zS_i-q_i=zT_i+b. Both use teacher information and are nondeployable counterfactuals; compare their top30 recall and teacher-cost regret with frozen student and teacher.
method.boundary: Descriptive inversion fraction among 10 teacher ranks 20..29 versus 10 ranks 30..39, computed within each saved bank.
method.aggregation: Episode is the unit. Take median over available banks within episode before overall, t0/t25, or round 10/20/30 summaries. No p-values or GO gate. Episode 15946 has no t25 bank and remains missing.

validity.saved_cost_control: All 93 k0 and 93 k5 recomputed official costs must match saved costs before a summary is written.
validity.failure_action: Fail closed on data identity, shapes, finiteness, saved cost alignment, or algebraic closure. Write no partial metric result.

execution.allocation: One guarded PBS GPU compute-node job; never load models or banks on a login node or local machine.
execution.data_handling: Read only existing train_banks.pt and frozen checkpoints; do not collect episodes, train, run CEM, or open validation/holdout banks.

claim_boundary: Teacher is a reference, not environment truth. Oracle corrections use teacher latents. This is a descriptive fixed-bank predictor diagnostic, not a deployable repair, CEM result, planner speedup, or closed-loop success.
